findings.anchor: Technology: Networks with Conditional Gaussian Variables
findings.supported_claim: Conditional Gaussian nodes have means linear in continuous parents; parameters can depend on discrete parents; discrete nodes cannot have continuous parents.
findings.consequence: A separate representation boundary, not a general continuous causal-decision engine.
